target.title: Doctor: expose systemd linger findings
target.body:
## Summary

- add default-disabled structured lint findings for `core/doctor/systemd-linger`
- keep legacy interactive/non-interactive linger enablement in the existing Doctor run paths
- gate structured linger findings on the same loaded Gateway systemd service precondition as the legacy Doctor path, so `--all`/`--only` stays quiet on hosts without an OpenClaw systemd user service

## Validation

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.test.ts --reporter=verbose` (72 tests) on rebased head `a39e27b668ee57f4ec3279bb9c6c739af7a3b3a9`
- `git diff --check`
- Prior local validation on this slice:
  - `./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.test.ts`
  - `./node_modules/.bin/oxlint src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.test.ts`
  - `CI=1 PNPM_CONFIG_VERIFY_DEPS_BEFORE_RUN=false node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.test.ts`
  - `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.core.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core.tsbuildinfo`
  - `node --max-old-space-size=8192 scripts/plugin-sdk-surface-report.mjs --check`
  - `node scripts/sync-plugin-sdk-exports.mjs --check`

## Real behavior proof

Behavior or issue addressed:
Selected `doctor --lint --only core/doctor/systemd-linger` should not warn merely because local Linux linger is disabled. It should only report disabled linger when OpenClaw is actually running through a loaded Gateway systemd user service, matching the legacy Doctor path.

Real environment tested:
Crabbox brokered Linux VM, provider `azure`, lease `cbx_6322dfa0e580`, slug `violet-shrimp`, run `run_2dd29a8828cc`, target `linux`, machine type `Standard_D32ads_v6`. The host had real systemd PID 1, an active user systemd manager, `openclaw-gateway.service` enabled as a user unit, and `loginctl show-user crabbox -p Linger` returned `Linger=no`.

Exact steps or command run after this patch:
1. Build source checkout with `pnpm build`.
2. Create a harmless user unit at `~/.config/systemd/user/openclaw-gateway.service` with `ExecStart=/bin/sleep infinity`.
3. `systemctl --user daemon-reload`
4. `systemctl --user enable openclaw-gateway.service`
5. `systemctl --user is-enabled openclaw-gateway.service`
6. `loginctl show-user crabbox -p Linger`
7. `OPENCLAW_SYSTEMD_UNIT=openclaw-gateway OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR=$(mktemp -d) OPENCLAW_CONFIG_PATH=$(mktemp -d)/config.json ./openclaw.mjs doctor --lint --json --only core/doctor/systemd-linger`
8. Disable and remove the proof unit, then `systemctl --user daemon-reload`.

Evidence after fix:
```text
provider proof host user=crabbox uid=1000
systemd
Linger=no

systemctl --user is-enabled openclaw-gateway.service
enabled
loginctl show-user crabbox -p Linger
Linger=no

doctor_exit=1
{"ok":false,"checksRun":1,"checksSkipped":32,"findings":[{"checkId":"core/doctor/systemd-linger","severity":"warning","message":"Systemd lingering is disabled for crabbox.","source":"doctor","target":"systemd.user.crabbox","requirement":"systemd user lingering enabled","fixHint":"Run: sudo loginctl enable-linger crabbox"}]}
ASSERT_SYSTEMD_LINGER_FINDING_OK
PROOF_97514_OK
```

Quiet-path proof:
Earlier WSL source CLI proof with `Linger=no` and no loaded Gateway systemd user service exited 0 and emitted no findings:
```text
{"ok":true,"checksRun":1,"checksSkipped":32,"findings":[]}
```

Observed result after fix:
The selected structured lint check stays quiet when the Gateway service is not loaded, and emits the warning only when a real Linux user systemd service for `openclaw-gateway` is loaded while linger remains disabled. Focused tests on the rebased head cover both the positive selected-lint warning path and the selected quiet path where `readSystemdUserLingerStatus` is not called unless the Gateway service is loaded.

What was not tested:
After rebasing to head `a39e27b668ee57f4ec3279bb9c6c739af7a3b3a9`, an exact-head Crabbox rerun was attempted, but the local wrapper timed out and subsequent `crabbox list/history` broker calls returned HTTP 500 (`error code: 1101`). The rebased head passed the focused Doctor contribution test file locally in WSL, and the systemd-linger implementation remains the same loaded-service gate proven by the Crabbox run above.

## Contract

No config schema, plugin manifest, SDK, persisted data model, or repair-path contract change. This adds only an opt-in structured Doctor lint finding for existing systemd-linger health behavior.
